items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well hopefully, I know Frank Alkyer is the editor.

ctx.x: I don’t know. It’s like a lot of people told me, it’s about time and well deserved. I agree with that. The only thing I’m annoyed about is that Down Beat hasn’t written anything about us in years and years. They’re right here in Chicago, and like they say, in your own backyard, you know.
Well hopefully, I know Frank Alkyer is the editor.
